notes: Sets a two-line status message (OpenGlModel.aString5600=title, TextureGenerator.aString2496=subtitle) and a global loading flag (ProjectedGroundDecor.aBoolean10238=isLoading). When not loading and both strings are empty, triggers a UI transition via GlRectangleTexture.method254(3,...); otherwise resets several 'load complete' flags (SceneTileBounds, ConfigShortValueNode, AbstractMenuEntryStatics, NpcDefinition, SceneRegionState, GroundDecorSceneEntity) and calls GlRectangleTexture.method254(-3,...) - consistent with switching between a 'still loading, show progress text' state and a 'loading finished' state. Called with (name,false,name2,decoy) from CameraConfigDefinition/HeadIconRenderer and (formattedCount,true,'',decoy) from GlElementArrayBuffer/LoadProgressCounters, supporting the 'title+subtitle while loading, then a login/world message once done' interpretation. decoy/i only feeds a discarded division inside the else-branch.
